title: Lighting and Photographing a Maquette
content: If you want to paint an imaginary scene that’s lit by believable outdoor light, set up the maquette outdoors.Set it up against a simple backdrop. Spin it around and try lighting it from different angles.Everything will scale correctly—meaning the quality of the light, shadows, and reflected light will be the same as they would be at full scale, relatively speaking.Read the full post for free on Substack
